thread:
sara_support: Hey team, getting multiple customer reports for elevated p95/p99 on a Dedicated cluster during a recent scale event. Ticket CS-8542. Observed spike around 10:38 UTC when attach queue length increased.

luca_oncall: +1 seeing same in dashboards — p99 jumped from ~220ms to ~1.9s during concurrent attach ramp. Affected tenant: acme-inc (demo env).

sara_support: Customer reported intermittent 504s on POST /v1/generate and retries that made tail worse.

raj_sre: Can you share alert links and any sample traces? I'm pulling provisioning and attach metrics now.

alina_platform: I'm seeing ReservedPool "eu-west-2-dedicated-3" hit 100% capacity and an attach backlog form. Autoscaler requested +6 nodes but each node spent ~45-60s in Attaching state.

deploy-bot: Provisioner event: scale_request id=sr-3302 started, requested=6, in_flight=6, success=0

sara_support: Short log from customer trace:
```
[2026-03-15T10:38:12Z] attach_time_ms=48000 reason=kernel-image-pull
[2026-03-15T10:38:15Z] attach_time_ms=62000 reason=nv_gpu_initialization
[2026-03-15T10:38:20Z] request_id=req-cc1234 status=timeout 504
```

luca_oncall: That looks like image pull + GPU init creating a cold-GPU tail. Also noticed occasional auth rotation failures that added ~8s to some attaches.

kevin_engineer: We recently adjusted linear thresholding on minpool fill to reduce churn. That change reduced pre-warm behavior; maybe too aggressive for bursty demo traffic so pools are under-prepared.

raj_sre: Repro plan: 1) generate 150 concurrent short requests (seq length 256) against dedicated pool 2) observe attach queue and p95/p99 3) capture provisioning traces. I'll run in staging.

sara_support: Customer needs interim mitigations. Proposed immediate steps: 1) temporarily increase min_pool for the affected reserved cluster by +2 2) enable pre-warm flag for priority queue 3) reroute high-value tenants to hosted fallback while we stabilize.

alina_platform: I can apply min_pool +2 and enable pre-warm for priority queue now. Rolling patch ETA ~4m.

kevin_engineer: Quick configuration suggestion: increase local image cache TTL and enable a fallback smaller kernel image on pull failure (KERNEL_IMAGE_FALLBACK=true).

luca_oncall: For immediate relief, reroute critical tenant IDs to hosted with sticky routing and mark their requests as priority so they skip normal fairshare queues.

sara_support: I'll coordinate comms. Assigning action items: @alina_platform do the pool change, @raj_sre run the repro and collect latency traces, @kevin_engineer toggle the fallback config.

alina_platform: Started change: updated min_pool 4 -> 6 for eu-west-2-dedicated-3. Pre-warm enabled for priority queue. Patch id=patch-507890-A

deploy-bot: Config change applied: patch-507890-A success on 4/4 nodes

raj_sre: Running repro now in staging. First pass: p95 dropped from ~1100ms -> ~220ms. p99 improved but still elevated ~680ms. Will monitor for 30m.

kevin_engineer: KERNEL_IMAGE_FALLBACK toggled, deploy logs look clean; fallback triggered for one node and recovered faster.

sara_support: Customer notified of mitigations and routing change. They'll validate on their side. Adding to follow-up postmortem if this persists. Thanks team :heart:

luca_oncall: Follow-ups to capture in postmortem:
- investigate why kernel images take ~60s to pull from our registry under load
- consider regional registry mirrors or local caching layer
- revisit linear threshold heuristics and increase min_prewarm for priority tenants

raj_sre: I'll open SRE-1298 with repro artifacts/graphs and link this thread.

sara_support: Closing this thread for now — re-open if p99 regresses. :white_check_mark:
